_comment: Policy-as-DATA for gate-coverage check 1/3 (adr_prose_status_contradiction) in the cloud-ci-cross-artifact-agreement gate. Closes #1327 defect class (a): an ADR whose BODY prose asserts a lifecycle status contradicting its own front-matter `status:`. The Rust matcher has ZERO scanner branches — it only walks this table: for each rule, an ADR whose normalized front-matter status token equals `frontmatter_status` and whose lower-cased body contains one of `forbidden_body_phrases` (already lower-cased here) yields a Finding keyed `{id}@{phrase}`. CONSERVATIVE by construction: only high-confidence self-referential contradiction phrases are listed, so a false positive is a reviewed DATA choice, not a heuristic guess. Extending the matcher (new status, new phrase) is a reviewed DATA edit here. Benign cross-references that trip a phrase on the live corpus are absorbed by the born-advisory gate-coverage-baseline.json; a NEW contradiction is a regression that blocks. Born pack-shaped: an adopting repo repoints these phrases; the kernel hardcodes none.

status_contradiction_rules._comment: An ACCEPTED ADR whose own prose says it is still Proposed contradicts its front-matter (the literal #1327 exhibit was 'stays Proposed' inside an Accepted ADR).
